influences.name: Deep Purple
influences.context: Then one day I was at a friend's house and I heard the song "Burn" by Deep Purple come on the radio.....I thought to myself......"Who is that!!??" So, I bought the "Burn" album.....and there it was....all my favourite types of music in one band!

influences.name: Glenn Hughes
influences.context: Glenn Hughes sounded like a white Stevie Wonder and his bass lines were very different than in most rock bands

influences.name: Jon Lord
influences.context: Jon Lord had classical music mixed in his solos

influences.name: David Coverdale
influences.context: David Coverdale had that cool thick bluesy rock sound to his voice

influences.name: Ritchie Blackmore
influences.context: Ritchie Blackmore was on another planet!! It was at that time that I wanted to try and learn how to play like Ritchie Blackmore!!

influences.name: Ronnie James Dio
influences.context: I'll never forget both the day I was asked to join Dio.....especially since Ronnie James Dio was and still is my favorite singer!

influences.name: Bob Ezrin
influences.context: I just remember listening to the "Pink Floyd" album he produced with Carmine Appice on it that we listened to on the tour bus while in Dio.

influences.name: Tony Iommi
influences.context: Well, I think he's the closest to Tony Iommi. Tony was one of his idols. Tracy plays heavy, thick guitar chords, great sense of feel, really doomy attitude

influences.name: Boards of Canada
influences.context: There's music, like Boards of Canada and Ulrich Schnauss, that inspired me.

influences.name: Ulrich Schnauss
influences.context: There's music, like Boards of Canada and Ulrich Schnauss, that inspired me.

influences.name: Photek
influences.context: Photek [Rupert Parkes] was the first person that inspired me where I was like, 'What is that sound? I've never heard anything like that.'

influences.name: Roni Size
influences.context: But then I saw Roni Size's Reprazent in 1996. They came to San Francisco and played at Bimbo's. He had a drummer, and a bassist, and it just blew my mind.

influences.name: Caribou
influences.context: The other artist was Caribou [Tape Op #37]. I'd seen him a few times and was like, 'Man, that's so engaging.' I think that planted the seed.

influences.name: Tame Impala
influences.context: Tame Impala [Tape Op #95] has always been an interesting reference point to me, and it's been interesting to see their progression.

influences.name: Peter Franco
influences.context: He's taught me a lot about what people are looking for, as well as how things can sound like a studio but have that live element to them.

influences.name: Count
influences.context: Definitely Count enabled me to think about that and achieve the vision of sharpening all those sounds, while maintaining the good elements.

influences.name: Martin Birch
influences.context: I had learnt so much from working with Martin Birch on Rainbow and Sabbath albums

influences.name: Roger Glover
influences.context: I had learnt so much from working with Martin Birch on Rainbow and Sabbath albums, also with Roger Glover in my Elf days
